Pentagon Revokes Ex-Air Force Secretary's Security Clearance

The Pentagon has revoked the security clearance of former Air Force Secretary Frank Kendall. This action was taken due to disclosures Kendall made regarding Air Force One's capabilities. Kendall had previously commented in media that a donated jumbo jet lacked standard modifications and presented a risk. The Pentagon stated the revocation was for disclosing classified information. The Toronto Star, Washington Post, CNN, Gulf News, and CBS News reported the Pentagon's action.
